description: Mari Energies Limited is an integrated energy company whose core business is upstream oil and gas exploration and production. It also has a services division offering gravity and magnetic services, seismic acquisition and processing, mud logging and drilling services for in-house needs and for other exploration and production companies, and it has expanded into minerals mining (copper, gold and rare earth elements) and technology through data centres. Mari Services is its in-house integrated E&P services arm, Mari Minerals (Pvt.) Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary established in 2023, and Mari Technologies Limited is its new subsidiary building large-scale data centres.
